cards.headline: Flick rules Koundé out of the Clásico and says the players are ready
cards.summary: Hansi Flick confirmed at Saturday’s press conference that Jules Koundé will not play against Real Madrid. The coach said the squad has recovered and he has good feelings ahead of the 21:00 kick-off at Spotify Camp Nou. He also warned that Barça must defend set pieces better than they did in Paris.
cards.body: Flick spoke at the Ciutat Esportiva the day before the first Clásico of the season. He told reporters Koundé’s ankle sprain from the Betis match leaves no room for risk. The Frenchman trained individually and did not join the group. Olmo remains out for around a month after the adductor injury suffered against PSG. Flick described the Clásico as the best match the sport offers and said millions of people will watch. He praised Mourinho as a successful colleague and said he trusts the referees. On set pieces he noted Real Madrid’s strength and said the squad worked on it in training. Barça lead La Liga by six points after nine wins. A victory would open a nine-point gap. Vinícius is banned for Madrid. The final training session took place on Saturday morning before the press conference.

cards.headline: Gavi says Clásicos are matches to go to war
cards.summary: Gavi told club media that Clásicos require a war mentality no matter how each side arrives. The midfielder warned that Real Madrid can hurt opponents at any moment, especially in the final minutes. Cristina Navarro reported the comments for MARCA on Saturday.
cards.body: Gavi spoke during the pre-match media day. He said both teams come out switched on from the first minute and that previous results do not matter. He recalled the 5-2 Supercopa win under Flick as one of his favourite Clásicos. On the PSG defeat he said the side competed well against a strong opponent and can take lessons into Sunday. He expects the Camp Nou crowd to push the team and hopes for three points. Fermín López spoke in the same session and stressed the need to control emotions and play their own game. Barça face Madrid with several defensive absences. Koundé is out, Eric García is sidelined for weeks and Christensen remains unavailable. The match is at Spotify Camp Nou at 21:00. Gavi has been a regular under Flick and is expected to feature in midfield alongside Pedri and Rodri.

cards.headline: Fermín says controlling emotions is key against Real Madrid
cards.summary: Fermín López told official channels that Barça must control emotions and play their own game to have a chance against Real Madrid. He said Clásicos are high-intensity matches he has dreamed of playing since he was young. The club posted the interview on Saturday.
cards.body: Fermín appeared in a club video ahead of the fixture. He stressed that details and concentration matter more than form or absences. He also said the side should not get distracted by outside noise. Gavi spoke in the same window and used stronger language about the need for a war mentality. Both players are expected to be available. Pedri has said he treats the match like any other and keeps his normal routine. Rodri was rested in Paris so he would be fresh. The Clásico is the first of the 2026/27 season. Barça have 27 points from nine wins. Madrid sit on 21. Official accounts also shared clips of training and player features, including Gordon’s first Clásico. Kick-off remains 21:00 at Spotify Camp Nou. Flick’s side completed their last session on Saturday morning.

cards.headline: Espart is the leading right-back option after Koundé is ruled out
cards.summary: Xavi Espart is expected to start at right-back against Real Madrid after Flick ruled Jules Koundé out. The 19-year-old scored and performed strongly against PSG. Flick called him an incredible player who still has room to improve. Renato Gonçalves covered the comments for Barca Blaugranes.
cards.body: Espart started and scored in the 4-2 defeat in Paris while marking Kvaratskhelia. He completed a high percentage of passes and looked comfortable on the right. With Koundé unavailable and Eric García out long-term, Flick has little choice. The coach said Espart is a professional who did well in recent matches. Madrid arrive without Vinícius. Yan Diomandé is among the wide threats Espart could face. Cubarsí and Gerard Martín are expected in central defence. Cancelo offers cover on the left. The squad finished Saturday’s session at the Ciutat Esportiva. Flick spoke at 13:00. The Clásico is at Spotify Camp Nou at 21:00. Barça can extend their lead at the top of La Liga. Espart called the match a war in earlier comments.

cards.headline: Official accounts post Clásico countdown and Gordon feature
cards.summary: FC Barcelona posted ‘Who’s excited for El Clásico?’ and a graphic about Anthony Gordon’s first Clásico on Saturday. The English and Spanish accounts also shared Flick quotes from the press conference. The posts ran as the squad completed final preparations.
cards.body: The countdown posts appeared throughout the afternoon and evening. One graphic noted a player looking for his seventh Clásico win. Gordon arrived in the summer and has featured in recent matches. Adeyemi has also spoken about his connection with Flick. Official channels had already shared training images and the Messi award congratulations earlier in the week. The match is confirmed for 21:00 at Spotify Camp Nou. Barça lead by six points. Real Madrid travel without Vinícius. Koundé is out and Olmo is sidelined. The mosaic is expected to read ‘Batec blaugrana’. Training finished on Saturday morning. Flick’s press conference followed. The official posts sit alongside coverage of player interviews with Gavi, Fermín and Pedri.

cards.headline: Flick warns Barça must improve defending set pieces
cards.summary: Hansi Flick said Real Madrid are among the best sides on set pieces and that Barça trained on the issue on Saturday. He said the team must defend those situations better than they did against PSG. Samuel Marsden and official accounts carried the comments.
cards.body: The warning came in the pre-match press conference. Flick noted Madrid’s physical power and quality on dead balls. The squad worked on the topic in the final training session. In Paris, Barça conceded late goals after Espart was replaced. The German coach said the players have recovered and he has good feelings. He confirmed Koundé will not play. Olmo is out for roughly a month. Barça sit top of La Liga with 27 points. Madrid have 21. A win would make the gap nine points. The match is at Spotify Camp Nou at 21:00. Vinícius is banned. Flick also said he trusts the referees and prefers to focus on his own team rather than outside talk.

cards.headline: Pedri treats the Clásico like any other match
cards.summary: Pedri said he prepares for Sunday’s Clásico with his usual routine and does not change anything because Real Madrid are the opponents. He also called Messi the best player in history. Joan Poquí reported the comments for Mundo Deportivo after the Media Day.
cards.body: Pedri spoke during the club’s Media Day. He acknowledged the size of the fixture but insisted on keeping normal preparation. He played a full season alongside Messi and said that year felt too short. He supports Newell’s Old Boys because of Messi. The Canary Islander started against PSG and is expected to play again. Rodri was managed in Paris with the Clásico in mind. Barça lead by six points. The match is at Spotify Camp Nou at 21:00. Gavi and Fermín also gave interviews on Saturday. Flick confirmed Koundé’s absence. The squad completed final training on Saturday morning. Pedri’s comments first appeared on Friday evening and continued to circulate on Saturday.

cards.headline: Barça can open a nine-point gap with a win at Spotify Camp Nou
cards.summary: Barcelona lead La Liga with 27 points from nine wins. Real Madrid sit third on 21. A home victory in the Clásico at 21:00 would open a nine-point gap. Vinícius is banned and Koundé is out. The match is the first of the 2026/27 season between the sides.
cards.body: LaLiga confirmed the kick-off weeks ago. Barça have been perfect in the league. Madrid arrive after a strong run of results under Mourinho. The last league Clásico at Camp Nou finished 2-0 to Barça and sealed the 2025/26 title. Six new or recent arrivals could feature for Barça, including Rodri, Jesus, Adeyemi, Gordon and Espart. Eric García and Christensen remain out. Olmo is sidelined for around a month. The mosaic is set to read ‘Batec blaugrana’. Official channels posted countdown material on Saturday. Flick spoke at 13:00 after the last training session. The institutional side of the fixture continues with no board lunch and limited Madrid representation in the box.

cards.headline: Flick says he has respect for Mourinho and trusts the referees
cards.summary: Hansi Flick called José Mourinho a successful colleague and said he trusts the quality of the refereeing. He preferred to focus on preparing his own team rather than outside talk about officials. The comments came in Saturday’s pre-Clásico press conference.
cards.body: Flick was asked about the referee debate that has run through the week. He said it will not affect the match and that everyone should protect the officials. He described Mourinho as a colleague who has succeeded at every club. On the PSG result he said the side analysed the game and can grow from it. He confirmed Koundé is unavailable and that Olmo will miss several matches. Barça completed their last training session on Saturday morning. The Clásico is at Spotify Camp Nou at 21:00. Barça can open a nine-point lead. Madrid travel without Vinícius. Official accounts shared several of Flick’s answers throughout the afternoon. The German coach also said the players have recovered and he has good feelings.
